# IMPERIA COLD WAR — Sami: Sweden 1970 and Nordic cooperation.
# COLDWAR Sweden. Generated by tools/sweden_1970/build_national.py.
# Update 22.11.2026: set_politics now names the ruling party (error.log fix).
COLDWAR_SWE_national_on_election_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_national_initialised
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_election_result_pending
	}
}
COLDWAR_SWE_national_election_result_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_national_initialised
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_election_result_pending
		}
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_election_result_pending
		add_to_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_election_generation = 1
		}
		# IMPERIA COLD WAR — 22.11.2026: set_politics needs ruling_party, otherwise the whole call is dropped.
		if = { limit = { has_government = democratic } set_politics = { ruling_party = democratic election_frequency = 36 } }
		else_if = { limit = { has_government = communism } set_politics = { ruling_party = communism election_frequency = 36 } }
		else_if = { limit = { has_government = fascism } set_politics = { ruling_party = fascism election_frequency = 36 } }
		else_if = { limit = { has_government = nationalist } set_politics = { ruling_party = nationalist election_frequency = 36 } }
		else = { set_politics = { ruling_party = neutrality election_frequency = 36 } }
		COLDWAR_SWE_national_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}
